performance_case.causal_mechanism: One common systemd writable mount-namespace parent lets the frozen same-filesystem Java directory rename remain atomic while existing Unix DAC and sticky-directory ownership continue to isolate private staging from published evidence; updating the release-lane trust root keeps that correction deployable fail closed.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task can prove only a six-file offline unit, verifier, two-test and documentation correction. It cannot prove live systemd namespace behavior, recover R1, create a future generation, complete 14 days, establish prediction, fees, slippage, PnL, drawdown, candidate readiness, OOS or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate strategy drawdown effect is zero. Avoiding deterministic evidence loss can shorten time to a later path-risk decision, but any drawdown improvement remains MISSING_PROOF until a separately preregistered matched-capital forward experiment passes.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Leaving the old two-child namespace deterministically loses each completed day; omitting the transitive release-lane SHA makes an otherwise correct fix undeployable. Broadening protocol semantics or repairing partial R1 bytes would contaminate forward evidence, so the corrected six-file slice and a new untouched generation are the minimum useful path.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Immediate fee-adjusted PnL is unchanged. The infrastructure value is preventing another deterministic publication failure so one future 14-day microstructure screen can produce or reject a strategy mechanism without another full-window delay.
